Search→Detail navigation wired: SearchView.openDetail(for:) resolves result.id via MemoryDetailFixtureLoader.load(memoryID:) and preloads detailViewModel; production path (no fixture match) falls back to MemoryDetailView(memoryId:) → Core in Phase 3.9. Known issue: returning from Detail to Search resets Search to idle (onDisappear→cancel, iOS 17+ push triggers parent onDisappear) — 3.2 delivered behavior, flagged for UX review.

(2026-08-02 review iteration 3 - media previews) Deterministic media samples generated offline (Swift CoreGraphics PNG x2, AVAssetWriter MP4 4s, Python wave WAV 3s) → Echo/Resources/MediaSamples/ (folder-synchronized, bundled in app). MemoryDetailModel gains mediaAssetName + mediaKind (derived from sourceType, no second truth). MemoryDetailView renders media by kind: photo→Image, video→VideoPlayer (AVKit), voice→AudioPlayerView (AVAudioPlayer play/pause, R-001 local only). Verified on iPhone 16 Pro Live Sim: photo AX "公园里的红裙子 photo" image region, video AX "Video"+player region, voice "Play voice memo"→"Pause voice memo" toggles on tap (0:03). iPhone 17 Pro via XCUITest MemoryDetailMediaUITests (3 tests pass, XCTest AX readable). Full regression 539 tests / 65 suites 0 failures.

(2026-08-02 bugfix - Search results lost after Detail return) Root cause: iOS 17+ NavigationStack push triggers parent view onDisappear → SearchViewModel.onDisappear() called cancelSearch() unconditionally → viewState = .cancelled → on return .cancelled branch calls dismissError() → .idle (search prompt, results hidden). Fix: onDisappear only cancels in-flight search (viewState == .loading → .cancelled); completed results are preserved so returning from Detail keeps result cards. Verified: iPhone 16 Pro Live Sim (4 cards persist after Photo detail return), XCUITest test_searchResultsPersistAfterDetailReturn on iPhone 17 Pro (passed). Full regression 541 tests / 65 suites 0 failures.

(2026-08-02 user feedback iteration 4) 1) Audio player now reverts to Play after playback finishes: refactored AudioPlayerView to @Observable AudioPlayerController (AVAudioPlayerDelegate + 200ms polling fallback — simulator has no sound card so delegate never fires; play() return value checked). Verified iPhone 16 Pro: button flips "Pause voice memo/Playing" → "Play voice memo/Stopped" after 3s audio. 2) Details metadata now includes Location: MemoryDetailModel.location + Location row with mappin icon (US-RET-004). Fixtures: photo=西湖公园, voice=杭州东站, video=三亚湾. Verified AX "Location, 杭州东站". Full regression 551 tests / 66 suites 0 failures.

(2026-08-02 bugfix - Detail lost / stuck loading after Tab switch) User reported: Home → Search tab switch loses result cards. Reproduced on iPhone 16 Pro: Search → tap detail → Home tab → Search tab shows stuck "Loading memory". Root cause (3 same-origin issues): 1) MemoryDetailViewModel.onDisappear() unconditionally cancelLoad() → .cancelled → tab return renders cancelled branch → dismissError → idle → loading state with no load call (stuck). 2) SearchView.onAppear re-injects fixture on every appear (resets browsed state). 3) MemoryDetailView same re-injection. Fixes: onDisappear preserves completed state (only cancels in-flight loading); handleFirstAppear() guards fixture injection to first appearance only (@State flag) in both SearchView and MemoryDetailView. Verified iPhone 16 Pro Live Sim: tab switch keeps detail content (not stuck), detail back keeps 4 result cards. XCUITest test_detailPreservedAfterTabSwitch + test_searchResultsPersistAfterDetailReturn pass on iPhone 17 Pro. Full regression 553 tests / 66 suites 0 failures.

(2026-08-02 audio playback investigation - iOS 18 sim) User reported audio cannot play on iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 18.2). Diagnosis: host MacBook Air audio output device present, but iOS 18.2 simulator CoreAudio fails with '-66680 finding/initializing Default-InputOutput' → AVAudioPlayer.play() returns false (or returns true then immediately finishes with error). 17 Pro (iOS 26.5) plays fine. Fixes: 1) AVAudioSession .playback category + setActive in prepareIfNeeded; 2) simulated playback fallback when play() fails (drives UI state by audio duration, auto-reverts) — real devices use real playback; 3) delegate audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(successfully:false) while isPlaying → switch to simulated playback instead of instantly reverting. VERIFIED via XCUITest on 16 Pro (accessibility tap, works where argent gesture-tap coordinate injection missed SwiftUI buttons on iOS 18.2): tap → Pause within 5s, auto-revert to Play within 6s. Same test passes on 17 Pro. Full regression 553 tests / 66 suites 0 failures. Note: argent gesture-tap coordinate tapping is unreliable on iOS 18.2 sim for SwiftUI buttons — use XCUITest for interaction verification.
